title: Structured Authority Injection: Persistent Human Control for LLM Agents via Typed MCP Overrides
abstract: arXiv:2610.22373v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly used as autonomous orchestrators in distributed and multi-agent systems, yet a control gap remains: no protocol-level mechanism allows human operators to inject binding directives that persist across planning cycles. Free-text overrides suffer from ambiguous interpretation due to lack of schema validation and from authority erosion as operator instructions lose influence within accumulating context. We propose Structured Authority Injection (SAI), a protocol that addresses these issues by routing operator corrections through typed, schema-validated Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool calls and maintaining a ranked authority context prepended to each LLM prompt. SAI defines three override classes (Constraint, Priority, and Strategy) with distinct persistence semantics and an explicit precedence order enforced via a directed authority channel inaccessible to the planning process. The method requires no model

translated_title: 结构化权限注入：通过类型化MCP覆盖实现对LLM智能体的持久人类控制
translated_abstract: 基于LLM的智能体越来越多地被用作分布式系统和多智能体系统中的自主编排器，但仍然存在一个控制缺口：目前没有协议级机制允许人类操作员注入能够在规划周期之间持续生效的约束性指令。自由文本形式的覆盖指令由于缺乏模式验证而导致解释含糊，并且随着操作员指令在不断累积的上下文中失去影响力而产生权限侵蚀。我们提出结构化权限注入（Structured Authority Injection, SAI），该协议通过类型化的、经过模式验证的模型上下文协议（MCP）工具调用来传递操作员的修正指令，并维护一个分级排序的权限上下文，将其前置到每条LLM提示中，从而解决上述问题。SAI定义了三类覆盖指令（约束Constraint、优先级Priority和策略Strategy），它们具有不同的持久化语义和明确的优先顺序，并通过一个规划过程无法访问的定向权限通道来强制执行。该方法无需模型（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出结构化权限注入（SAI）协议，通过类型化、模式验证的MCP工具调用和分级权限上下文，使人类操作员能够向LLM智能体注入跨规划周期持续生效的约束性指令，解决自由文本覆盖指令的歧义解释与权限侵蚀问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Structured Authority Injection (SAI), a protocol enabling persistent human control over LLM agents through typed, schema-validated MCP tool calls and ranked authority contexts, addressing the ambiguity and authority erosion inherent in free-text overrides.
